packaging.title: Packaging Verification
tips: Check if printing is clear and exquisite
Check if pull tab is transparent and easy to pull
Check if steel stamp is clear and consistent
Feel if packaging material is thick and stiff

cigarette.title: Cigarette Verification
tips: Measure length and circumference match specs
Check if tobacco is golden and oily
Check if filter is full and firmly attached
Smell if there is unique aroma
Check if burning is even and ash is gray-white
